destination.name: Winton
destination.tagline: The outback town where Waltzing Matilda was first performed and dinosaurs roamed
destination.description: Winton is a small town in outback Queensland, about two hours from Longreach. It is where Waltzing Matilda was first performed in 1895, and it was the first headquarters of the company that became Qantas. The surrounding country is rich in dinosaur fossils, including Australovenator, which is named for the town. Quirky stops such as Arno's Wall and the Musical Fence add to the outback character.

goodToKnow.title: Summer heat
goodToKnow.detail: Summer days often reach 40°C. Visitor season runs April to October, and tours and experiences are reduced outside it.

goodToKnow.title: Bring a car
goodToKnow.detail: There is no public transport in town and the nearest hire cars are in Longreach, about two hours away. The dinosaur sites involve unsealed roads.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Visit in {months}, when the outback is milder and tours run. Summer is harsh, with days often reaching 40°C.
